research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Deepcell is engaged in developing methods and systems for cell analysis, as described in 'Methods and systems for cell analysis,' which details a cartridge with fluid and pneumatic ports for processing cells. 'Systems and methods for particle analysis' outlines imaging devices capturing multi-angle cell images for analysis. 'Compositions, systems, and methods for multiple analyses of cells' describes imaging, staining, and rotating cells for detailed examination. These efforts focus on advanced single-cell classification and isolation.

about_short_description.short_description: Deepcell is a life science company specializing in AI-powered single-cell classification and isolation for basic and translational research.

product.name: REM-I Platform
product.description: An integrated instrument and software platform for label-free, high-dimensional single-cell imaging, AI-based morphology analysis, and gentle six-way sorting of viable cells.

product.name: Deepcell Express
product.description: A send-in research service that provides academic users with AI-based single-cell morphology analysis and publication-grade imaging data without requiring an REM-I instrument.

product.name: Spark Program
product.description: A sample-based proof-of-concept service combining REM-I imaging, label-free cell sorting, high-dimensional morphology analysis, and scientific consultation.
